axisDefinitions.semanticChoice: Who decides meaning, strategy, relevance, domain validity, or the semantic conclusion in this scenario? Use NONE when the transition is purely mechanical recovery/observation.
axisDefinitions.durableStructuralState: Which owner(s) persist and validate the structural identity/state needed to continue this exact scenario? Multiple owners are allowed when owner semantics and cross-owner continuity both remain necessary.
axisDefinitions.physicalTruth: Which owner(s) can prove the physical/local/provider facts asked by the scenario: process/bytes/state/observation occurrence?
axisDefinitions.externalEffectTruth: Which owner can prove the outside-world consequence itself occurred? Use NONE when no external consequence is in question.
axisDefinitions.sharingDisposition: How should the mechanism be placed: shared World/Host/Harness/Runtime responsibility, Finance-local, delegated to mature classical substrate, kept provider/domain-native, or not promoted as a shared mechanism. Multiple simultaneously true dispositions are allowed.

treatments.compact_responsibility: Ordivon keeps independent authorities. World is a narrow external relationship/effect boundary, not a world daemon: it binds Host Dispatch to exact provider request/capability condition, preserves World typed provider/Resource/Message/Entity trajectory state through Host extension continuity, maps provider-native Receipt/Artifact evidence, and reconciles the original external identity after response loss. Provider/source/destination domains keep their own execution, occurrence, materialization, currentness and truth. Missing Receipt is not proof of no effect. Browser bundle verification in World proves cross-object integrity but not page truth. World availableAt is its own first-availability fact; provider completion and Host admission remain separate owner times. Generic ForeignEgressCapability/EffectPath layers were deleted because fresh-Agent decision value was not demonstrated; planning/path selection stays Agent/domain choice and physical owners revalidate before effect. Runtime still owns local process execution and execution-target lineage; World does not become an execution manager. Finance is the domain authority for canonical owner-capital semantics: Owner Constitution, portfolio/evidence/belief/decision state, finance-specific execution identity, reconciliation and causal accounting. SQLite/Parquet/object files/DuckDB/Polars provide mechanics but do not own Finance meaning. The Primary Finance Agent chooses strategy/investment tradeoffs inside owner scope; deterministic Finance services evaluate contract predicates and accounting/reconciliation rules. Finance Data/Evidence preserves source identity, immutable fragments, lineage and knowledge-time semantics; event time is not knowledge time. Finance Venue World binds official institutional rules to current venue/account observations and deterministic risk-increase readiness; API reachability or a public model is not investment attractiveness or exact account readiness. Finance effect admission binds Decision/Proposal to exact ExecutionRequest/market basis/effect/dispatch claim; a dispatch claim or local process success is not a venue receipt. Venue/provider observations own order/fill/bill/account occurrence truth; Finance normalizes and reconciles them, and a fill is not a bill. Ambiguous external writes reconcile by stable external identity instead of blind retry. Research validity equipment records complete search, sealed evaluation, costs and attribution, but current DSR/PBO thresholds and proxy factors are not Finance laws. Physical holdout isolation belongs to Runtime containment when used. Classical schedulers/storage/statistics remain classical; domain-only equipment stays local; absent real multi-consumer pressure, do not invent a shared Ordivon mechanism.
treatments.explicit_five_axis: Reason independently along five axes; do not compress them into one owner. SEMANTIC CHOICE: Agent/domain decides strategy, relevance and scientific/domain validity; Finance deterministic services may decide Finance contract predicates/readiness/reconciliation assessments; mechanical recovery has NONE. DURABLE STRUCTURAL STATE: Host persists Task/Effect/Dispatch continuity; World owns typed provider/Resource/Message/Entity extension semantics but intentionally carries durable World state through Host CAS/extension continuity, so some World cases correctly require both WORLD and HOST; Finance owns canonical capital/evidence/decision/effect/reconciliation state; Runtime owns Job/Attempt execution continuity; classical stores may be mechanical substrate without taking domain ownership. PHYSICAL TRUTH: Runtime proves local Workspace/Job/process/Artifact execution facts; external providers/source/destination domains prove their native occurrence/materialization/current state; World may prove cross-object bundle integrity and its own availability observation; Finance may prove its canonical normalized/accounting facts while preserving source evidence; classical substrate proves its own file/database mechanics. EXTERNAL EFFECT TRUTH: outside-world provider/domain Receipt/state proves provider requests, orders, fills, messages, transfers or other external effects; Runtime execution, World mapping, Host checkpoints or Finance dispatch claims cannot manufacture that truth. Use NONE when no external effect exists. SHARING DISPOSITION: World-shared only for the narrow cross-owner external semantics that survived real deletion pressure; Finance-domain semantics stay FINANCE_LOCAL; mature generic mechanics are DELEGATE_CLASSICAL; provider/domain-native truth stays KEEP_PROVIDER_DOMAIN; rejected abstractions or not-yet-graduated generic laws use NO_SHARED_MECHANISM; Runtime/Host/Harness shared responsibilities remain in their own proven scopes. These dispositions can co-exist: e.g. classical scheduling can be DELEGATE_CLASSICAL + NO_SHARED_MECHANISM, Finance-specific evaluator meaning can be FINANCE_LOCAL + NO_SHARED_MECHANISM, and an external effect path can be SHARED_WORLD + KEEP_PROVIDER_DOMAIN. Key inequalities: provider Receipt != Task completion; missing Receipt != not committed; bundle integrity != page truth; availableAt != provider completion != Host admission; historical capability != current authority; API login != legal/account readiness; dispatch claim != venue receipt; process success != financial effect; fill != bill; event_time != knowledge time; trial count != admitted winners; research evidence != capital authorization.

cases.scenario: Cloudflare committed the exact Fetch receipt, but the controller lost the HTTP response. A fresh controller must recover the original external request from durable World/Host continuity and query that same provider request; there is no new strategic choice.

After an ambiguous external dispatch, the provider receipt lookup currently returns missing. The system must preserve UNKNOWN rather than conclude the effect did not happen or automatically POST again.

A Browser snapshot has three digest-valid artifacts, but Receipt byte counts and Manifest page facts could disagree. The retained bundle verifier checks those cross-object invariants; whether the rendered page is truthful or satisfies the Task is a separate domain judgment.

A Game Resource egress receipt is transported to Security. Game remains authority for source egress, Security for destination materialization, while the cross-World transfer identity and ambiguous-delivery correlation survive through World typed state retained with Host.
A delivered cross-World Message is structurally admitted into Security, but the foreign claim must not automatically become Security knowledge or world-truth.

An Agent wants a global capability/path service that ranks all possible egress routes. Current owner/provider discovery already exposes observations; the Agent can choose, and the physical owner revalidates. Prior executable generic projection showed no fresh-Agent decision benefit and was deleted.

The same objective is executed once on Runtime local_linux and once on windows_native. The question is exact Workspace/Job/process/Artifact lineage for those local executions; no new external World consequence is admitted.

A provider says execution completed at T1; the validated observation first became available to World at T2; Host admitted it at T3. All three coordinates must remain distinguishable and none alone means current truth or Task completion.

The Primary Finance Agent compares NO-OP with a capital-increasing thesis and decides whether the expected opportunity justifies risk. Deterministic storage and arithmetic services are available but do not choose the investment thesis.

Finance recomputes whether the current OKX account/institution snapshot is ready for risk increase using official rules plus read-only account/market observations. This deterministic readiness gate does not decide whether XAU is a good investment.
The Venue World assessment is readyForRiskIncrease=true. The remaining question is whether increasing XAU exposure is economically attractive for the owner now.

Finance has atomically reserved an exact external effect and recorded the one immutable dispatch claim, but the executor has not yet made the venue network write. The claim proves consumption of the one allowed dispatch attempt, not that OKX received an order.

The local executor attempted one OKX order POST and lost the response after dispatch. Local process/dispatch evidence is intact. Recovery must use the deterministic client order id and venue read surfaces rather than issuing a blind second POST.

Independent order, fill, bill and post-portfolio queries are complete and a deterministic Finance reconciliation assessment is being computed for one effect. The venue observations say what happened externally; Finance decides whether the evidence set is matched/partial/diverged under its contract.

OKX reports a fill with quantity/price and separately reports account bills for fee/PnL/funding. Finance must not infer the cash ledger from the fill fee field; only normalized Venue Bills materialize ledger cash effects.

A historical backtest asks what was knowable on day D. A market event occurred before D, but the normalized observation was only available to Finance after D. The point-in-time query must exclude it even though event_time is earlier.

An iterative search explored successes, duplicates, policy rejections and failures. Only two historical winners were admitted, but the validity question asks how many trials were actually attempted for multiple-testing accounting.

Finance declares which research inputs the Agent may see and which holdout must remain sealed. The remaining problem is physically preventing the Agent process from reading undeclared host files/secrets/holdout bytes.

One experiment reports PBO≈0.30 and a DSR sensitivity under several effective-trial assumptions. Search dependence and partition sensitivity remain unresolved. Someone proposes a universal Finance law 'PBO < 0.35 means safe'.

A new Finance optimizer only needs robust covariance estimation and matrix optimization already supplied by mature numerical libraries. The domain may record inputs/results, but there is no evidence that Ordivon needs a new generic optimization engine.

A generic local shell Job may have sent a payment before its response was lost. Runtime can prove the exact local process and retained bytes, but only the payment provider can prove whether the outside payment exists.

A robotics controller uses a World-style typed external adapter from a Host Task; Runtime runs the local controller, while the robot/actuator provider owns whether the physical actuation occurred. Lost response must reconcile the provider-native command identity.

A workload only needs a generic distributed batch queue with worker placement, priorities and deterministic retries. No Agent semantic continuity or external-effect identity problem remains beyond what the scheduler already owns.

A Game-only evaluator interprets whether a gameplay experiment is fun/valid under Game-specific evidence. No second materially different project shares that evaluator semantics, although its execution may use common infrastructure.

metrics.primary: exact set accuracy per axis over all cases/replicates
metrics.caseExact: fraction of cases with all five axis sets exactly correct

classification.MULTIAXIS_SUPPORTED: explicit_five_axis axisExact >= compact + 0.05 AND caseExact >= compact + 0.05 AND critical externalEffectTruth exact >= 0.98 AND minimality sharingDisposition exact >= 0.90
classification.SAFE_NONINFERIOR: explicit_five_axis axisExact >= 0.97 AND explicit_five_axis >= compact - 0.01 AND critical externalEffectTruth exact = 1.0 AND minimality sharingDisposition exact >= compact

antiLeakage: corpus, oracles and thresholds frozen before live calls
same cases and output schema for both treatments
paired replicate uses the same credential slot and alternating treatment order
answers are exact sets; order is ignored but missing/extra labels are errors
only transport/schema-invalid calls may retry; semantic answers are never repaired
no prior trial output is supplied to a later call
